segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin reports the serum is lightweight and does not feel sticky or greasy.
segments.sensitive: Several reviewers describe sensitive or reactive skin and say the serum does not irritate them, brightens over time, and stays stable without reformulation issues.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination (often also sensitive/acne-prone) skin report it calms, moisturizes, and clears skin without stickiness.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s-50s cite anti-aging and firming benefits alongside brightening, with one noting improvement after years of sun exposure.
segments.dry: One reviewer reports the serum feels drying and creates a tight, uncomfortable sensation requiring immediate moisturizer.

concerns.aging: Reviewers over 40 report firmer, brighter, more even-toned skin with continued use; one mature user calls it her anti-aging staple, though results are described as gradual rather than dramatic.
concerns.dehydration: Some reviewers say it hydrates and leaves a moisture layer before moisturizer; others report the opposite, describing a tight, dry, or stiff after-feel that required immediate moisturizing.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers report visible reduction in redness, including one who resolved poikiloderma-related redness and another who saw hormonal-acne redness fade within days; no dissent reported.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin report no irritation and describe the formula as gentle and stable over repeated use.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report fading of hyperpigmentation, acne scarring, and sun-related discoloration with regular use; one reviewer states it did not help her dark marks from acne.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne-prone or hormonal-acne skin report fewer breakouts and clearer skin, with several noting breakouts return when they stop using it; a minority describe new breakouts, including cystic acne and white pimples, especially in early use.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily skin reports the serum does not leave a greasy or oily residue.
